name: Vidcomic – Video
description: Create video clips with the connected providers, play them and edit them with ffmpeg.
long_description: Creates clips with the video providers connected in OmniWrench (Gemini Veo, OpenAI, xAI, Runway, Luma, Seedance, MiniMax, fal.ai, Replicate and more), optionally from a start image. Clips are played inside OmniWrench and can be edited with ffmpeg: trim, convert to GIF, remove sound, add music, save a still. On Windows OmniWrench downloads ffmpeg on request (once for Groovitron and Vidcomic).
author: KuroShiro
